scope: GC05: finite canonical materialized ordinary cycles with real public destructor callbacks and one collector retrace, when legacy and claimed ordered count images agree
behavior: The candidate plan's actual compacted BUFFER, GRAPH and PROXIES determine both ordered (VISIT, COUNTED) walks. A materialized nonempty-DTORS plan is admitted only when those images agree. An installed materialized callback plan rechecks after callback mutation on PASS1; a quiet fresh already-CALLED materialized plan also rechecks before using the legacy walk. Unequal images refuse explicitly. The existing callback snapshot, destructor return, protected free, single PASS1 retrace, physical owner extraction and quiet claimed walk remain unchanged. The historical selector requires an ordinary INSTANCE table in the prior graph, excluding stdClass-only callback/worker plans.

limits: Count-ambiguous callback graphs need persistent authenticated first-claim order across callback mutation. WeakMap callbacks, cached-worker/residual/overlap and callback reentry paths, hooks, active Fiber/frame/iterator contexts, wider postcallback rooting and arbitrary callback-created tables remain partial. This milestone does not close core GC.
